The evidence is stronger on systemic concealment, retaliation, and manipulation than on a direct paper trail of personal corruption.","evidence":[{"title":"Journalists Ordered to Serve Five Years in Prison in Iran","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-10-24","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/10/24/journalists-ordered-serve-five-years-prison-iran","summary":"Iran’s judiciary enforced prison sentences against journalists for reporting on Mahsa Amini’s death and framed the case as “propaganda against the state.” This is direct evidence of punishing truthful reporting and normalizing fear.","question_ids":["7B.10","7B.7","7B.8","7B.6"]},{"title":"Two years after Woman, Life, Freedom, impunity for crimes reigns supreme","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-09-11","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/09/iran-two-years-after-woman-life-freedom-uprising-impunity-for-crimes-reigns-supreme/","summary":"Amnesty said there were no effective, impartial investigations into killings, torture, sexual violence, or disappearances, and that families seeking truth faced harassment and arbitrary detention. This is strong evidence of concealment, retaliation, and refusal to accept accountability.","question_ids":["7B.10","7B.7","7B.6","7B.8"]},{"title":"Iran barred many experienced inspectors, IAEA board demanded reversal","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-06-05","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/iaea-board-passes-resolution-against-iran-on-cooperation-inspectors-3472087","summary":"Iran had barred many of the IAEA’s top enrichment experts, and the board demanded reversal. That undercuts claims of transparent, good-faith conduct in a sensitive domain.","question_ids":["7B.10","7B.8","7B.6","7B.7"]},{"title":"Iran’s presidential election dominated by Khamenei loyalists","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-06-25","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/irans-presidential-election-dominated-by-khamenei-loyalists-3494879","summary":"Reuters said Khamenei ensured hardline candidates dominated the contest and that the Guardian Council approved only five hardliners and one low-profile moderate from 80 applicants. This supports a pattern of managed politics and loyalty-first access rather than ethical, trust-building rule.","question_ids":["7B.10","7B.9","7B.8","7B.7"]},{"title":"Iran will not impede IAEA access, head of its atomic organisation says","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-12-14","url":"https://theprint.in/world/iran-will-not-impede-iaea-access-head-of-its-atomic-organisation-says/2403254/","summary":"Iran said it would not obstruct IAEA access and would operate within safeguards. This is a limited positive signal for procedural openness, but it is narrow and late.","question_ids":["7B.10","7B.8","7B.6"]},{"title":"Tehran signals no retaliation against Israel after drones attack","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-04-19","url":"https://theprint.in/world/tehran-signals-no-retaliation-against-israel-after-drones-attack/2048236/","summary":"Tehran downplayed the Isfahan incident and said it had no retaliation plan, which Reuters said appeared aimed at averting region-wide war. This is the clearest positive case of short-term restraint and a public line that looks relatively candid.","question_ids":["7B.10","7B.8","7B.7"]},{"title":"Iran says nuclear weapons have no place in its nuclear doctrine","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-04-22","url":"https://www.yahoo.com/news/iran-says-nuclear-weapons-no-085328983.html","summary":"Iran publicly denied any nuclear-weapons role in doctrine, and Reuters noted Khamenei’s long-standing fatwa. This is a real positive signal for formal commitment, but it is declaratory rather than proof of sustained ethical leadership.","question_ids":["7B.10","7B.8","7B.6"]},{"title":"Ayatollah Khamenei pardons, commutes sentences of over 2,000 Iranian inmates","publisher":"Press TV","date":"2024-04-06","url":"https://www.presstv.ir/Detail/2024/04/06/723171/-Supreme-Leader-Ayatollah-Khamenei-pardons-commutes-sentences-of-over-2%2C000-Iranian-inmates","summary":"Khamenei used his clemency power for 2,127 inmates, including some security-related cases and minors. This is the strongest positive item I found, but it is discretionary mercy, not a durable ethical standard.","question_ids":["7B.10","7B.7","7B.8","7B.9"]},{"title":"Iran reduces sentence of jailed journalists after clearing them of collaborating with US","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-10-13","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/commodities-news/iran-reduces-sentence-of-jailed-journalists-after-clearing-them-of-collaborating-with-us-3660786","summary":"A court dropped one charge and reduced the journalists’ sentences, which is the closest corrective signal I found. But they were still punished for reporting on Amini’s death, so this is only partial relief.","question_ids":["7B.10","7B.7","7B.8","7B.6"]},{"title":"Iran’s revolutionary guards extend control over Tehran’s oil exports","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-12-18","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/commodities-news/irans-revolutionary-guards-extend-control-over-tehrans-oil-exports-sources-say-3778558","summary":"Reuters reported the IRGC controlled up to half of Iran’s oil exports through shadow fleets and front companies. That is strong background evidence of clientelist, opaque control over revenue rather than an ethical, trust-building state.","question_ids":["7B.10","7B.9","7B.4","7B.8"]}]}
